violations.why: disable_isr(1) only masks irq_willow. irq_kestrel (priority 2) can still run between the check and the reset, so the reset can overwrite its decrement.
irq_kestrel can modify v_basalt after the rand() store and before the task's check. The check then reads a value the task did not write.
irq_willow is still enabled between line 30 and disable_isr(1) at line 20. It can modify v_basalt before the task reads it at line 21.
irq_kestrel has higher priority and can preempt irq_willow's non-atomic increment. The increment's write then overwrites the decrement.
